title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 1.1 Introduction to Whole Numbers: Use place value with whole numbers
summary: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 1.1 Introduction to Whole Numbers: Use place value with whole numbers
body: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, section "1.1 Introduction to Whole Numbers", prints these objectives: "Use place value with whole numbers" "Identify multiples and apply divisibility tests" "Find prime factorizations and least common multiples". The section text says: "A more thorough introduction to the topics covered in this section can be found in Prealgebra in the chapters Whole Numbers and The Language of Algebra ." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
